- Initial release of "federal-immigration-expert": a skill for real-time Canadian IRCC Express Entry/CRS/CEC/FSW/FST policy eligibility and scoring, based strictly on live official data.
- Fetches and monitors authoritative IRCC policy pages daily, auto-detecting and pushing any significant changes.
- Supports multi-channel eligibility assessment and CRS detailed calculation for any candidate profile via stdin JSON.
- Includes clear explanation of inclusion rules, scoring breakdowns, references, and actionable tips for maximizing immigration scores.
- Never relies on outdated offline tables—every assumption is verified with a fresh official source snapshot.
